frames.action: press 'Up' -- move the New Game selection up off Preset Character and onto Custom Character
frames.commentary: Not off a shelf. If I must be someone, let me be built by hand.

frames.action: press 'Return' -- take the Custom Character entry
frames.commentary: Right then. Let us see what I look like written down.

frames.action: press 'f' -- finish the world settings as they stand
frames.commentary: I have no opinions about how the world is shaped. It is the one I woke up in.

frames.action: press 'Y' -- confirm the world at a case-sensitive prompt that wants a capital
frames.commentary: Yes. I am finished deciding about the shape of the world.

frames.action: press 'shift+Tab' -- step back to the points page before choosing anything else
frames.commentary: If I am going to be honest about my own weight I want to see the ledger first.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- move down off the freeform budget onto the multiple-pools budget
frames.commentary: A version of me with no limits is not a person. It is a wish.

frames.action: press 'Return' -- take the multiple-pools budget so every gain has to be paid for
frames.commentary: Strong somewhere means paying for it somewhere else.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the scenario page
press 'slash' -- open the filter on the list of starts
frames.commentary: There is a long list here and I know the one I want.

frames.action: press 'm' -- begin spelling the start I am looking for

frames.commentary: I did not get out. That is the truth of it, so that is the one I take.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the profession page
press 'slash' -- open the filter on the trades
frames.commentary: I already know the answer to this one.
H. Fisher. Thirty-one seasons of it.
Thirty-one seasons. It is the only honest answer.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move on from the trade
press 'Tab' -- move on to the stats page

frames.commentary: Thirty-one years of hauling traps over a gunwale.
I can still put a full trap on the rail without thinking about it.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- move down to dexterity and leave it alone
frames.commentary: My hands are ordinary. I have never been quick, only steady.
I left school at sixteen for the boats. Books come slowly.
And here is what I got instead.
I can read a change in the water at half a mile.
I notice things before I have decided to. It is the only talent I would claim.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move on to the traits page
frames.commentary: Now what is wrong with me, and what is right.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- open the filter on the traits
frames.commentary: Start with the thing that will kill me.

frames.action: press 'b' -- begin spelling the first flaw

frames.commentary: There it is, in a list, like a diagnosis.
Six years of it. One bad twist and I am on the floor.
And the other thing I have always known about myself.

frames.action: press 's' -- begin spelling the second flaw

frames.commentary: Let us see it written down.
Thirty-one years bunked over a diesel. Noise never wakes me.

frames.action: press 'a' -- begin spelling the third flaw

frames.commentary: T. It runs straight down my mother side of the family.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- move down past the resistant one to the addictive one
frames.commentary: That is the wrong way round. I am not the resistant kind.
The boats ran on coffee and cigarettes. So did I.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- open the filter for what is right with me
press 't' -- begin spelling the first boon

frames.commentary: H. I do not break easily.
Thrown against a gunwale in February, back at work by noon.

frames.action: press 's' -- begin spelling the second boon
press 'Up' -- move up off the weak stomach
press 'Up' -- move up again to the strong one

frames.commentary: I have eaten whatever was going, all my working life.

frames.action: press 'o' -- begin spelling the third boon
press 'Escape' -- asked "Return to main menu?" over the creator instead of clearing the filter, with [N]o already selected
frames.commentary: No. I am not starting over.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: Still that question in front of me.

frames.action: press 'p' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: It is waiting on my answer, not on me.

frames.action: press 'a' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'c' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: I have not given it one yet.

frames.action: press 'k' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'm' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Return' -- answered the abandon-creation confirmation on its selected [N]o, closing it and leaving the creator as it was
frames.commentary: No. I know who I am. Get on with it.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- asked "Return to main menu?" a second time; it does not clear a filter
press 'Tab' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: It wants an answer before it will let me on.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: Nothing moves until I answer it.

frames.action: press 's' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'w' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'i' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'm' -- the abandon-creation confirmation still held the input, so this reached nothing; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: Waiting on me, and only on me.

frames.action: press 'Return' -- answered the confirmation on [N]o again, closing it and returning to the creator
frames.commentary: No. I am staying. Now let me finish.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move on from the traits to the skills
frames.commentary: What I can actually do, then.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- open the filter on this list
frames.commentary: There is one thing here I have already done for real.
Swimming. Twice over the side in nine years, and twice back aboard.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- reopen the filter so I can empty it
press 'BackSpace' -- rub out a letter; nothing on the screen changed
press 'BackSpace' -- rub out the last letter; nothing on the screen changed

frames.commentary: Show me the whole of it.

frames.action: press 'm' -- type over what is already there

frames.commentary: Nine years I kept that diesel turning over with my hands and my ears.

frames.action: press 'plus' -- put my hands on it properly
frames.commentary: I know what a bad bearing sounds like before I ever see it.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- reopen the filter for one more
press 'f' -- type over what is there

frames.commentary: Mending. Nets, line, canvas. A boat is held together by whoever is aboard her.
I have spliced line in the dark with cold hands. It counts for something.

frames.action: press 'a' -- ask it how old I am
frames.commentary: Fifty-two years, and most of them wet.

frames.action: press '5' -- type over the number it guessed

frames.commentary: Thirty-one of those seasons out of Gloucester, and nine on my own keel.

frames.action: press 'n' -- ask it what to call me
frames.commentary: They ought to know what to call me.

frames.action: press 'space' -- leave a gap before the rest of my name; the capture is unchanged because a space paints no pixels, and frame_00151.png shows the field reading "Odette Vachon" with the gap in place
frames.commentary: And my father name after it.
Odette Vachon. Out of Gloucester, and before that out of Cheticamp.

frames.action: press 'at' -- put right what it has wrong about me
frames.commentary: It has me down wrong. I am a woman, and fifty-two years of one.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- look over the whole of it before I commit
frames.commentary: Let me see all of it laid out before I say yes.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- say that is the whole of me
frames.commentary: That is the whole of me. Nothing left to add that would be true.

frames.action: press 'Y' -- yes, let the rest go
frames.commentary: Yes. Let it go. I am not going to pretend to be better than I am.
Yes. Salem is south of here, and Camille is somewhere in it.

frames.action: press 'w' -- reach for something that is actually a weapon
frames.commentary: A rod is for fish. Give me the knife.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- filter down to the one I want
press 'Return' -- narrow the list to it

frames.commentary: It cuts. That is all I need it to do.

frames.action: press 'w' -- ask again for the knife; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Return' -- narrow to the knife alone
frames.commentary: That one, and nothing else on the list.

frames.action: press 'Right' -- take it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'w' -- once more, slowly; nothing on the screen changed
press 'question' -- find out how this is properly done
frames.commentary: Let me find out how this is properly done.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- close that and look at where I actually am
frames.commentary: Enough of that. Where am I standing.

frames.action: press 'Return' -- put the rod down first, then; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: Put the rod down first, then.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- look for what it is offering me; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: There must be something on this list.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- leave it, the rod will do
frames.commentary: Leave it. The rod will do, and my hands know it better anyway.

frames.action: press 'Left' -- step away from the shopfront; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: Whatever is out there is out the front. So I go the other way.

frames.action: press 'apostrophe' -- acknowledge them without switching off my guard; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: I can see them. Seventeen yards is not close enough to freeze.

frames.action: press 'Left' -- step away from the shopfront
frames.commentary: Whatever is out there is out the front. So I go the other way.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- north along the inside wall; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: North, along the inside wall, away from that big window.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- further back; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: Further back. Glass is no kind of wall.

frames.action: press 'exclam' -- stop the alarm telling me what I can already see; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: I know they are there. I have my own eyes.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- north one step, there is a back door in this wall
frames.commentary: North one step. There is a back door in this wall.
Someone bled here, and not recently. Still better than out front.

frames.action: press 'c' -- close the door behind me
frames.commentary: Close it behind me. No sense advertising.
Sit tight. Listen. That is most of what fishing ever was.
Wait a while, then. I have done nothing else for thirty-one years.

frames.action: press '7' -- three hours, and let the street get bored of itself
frames.commentary: Three hours. Let the street get bored of itself.

frames.action: press 'I' -- let the groaning be, and keep still
frames.commentary: Groaning. If I jump at every one I will never sleep again.
Nothing has come through that door. Again, then.
Six hours. The afternoon can have itself.
Still nothing at that door. Good.

frames.action: press 'Right' -- back in through that door
frames.commentary: Back inside. A door between me and the street is worth more than fresh air.

frames.action: press 'c' -- and shut it; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: And shut. I will find water at first light, not at dusk.

frames.action: press 'Right' -- through properly, off the threshold
frames.commentary: Through properly. I was standing in the doorway like a fool.

frames.action: press 'c' -- now shut it behind me
press 'bar' -- one thing before I lie down
frames.commentary: One thing before I lie down.
Set the alarm. Water is the first job tomorrow and I want daylight for it.
Dawn. Ten hours and change. If I am still breathing then, water is the first thing.

frames.action: press 'dollar' -- lie down and try to sleep
frames.commentary: I sleep like the dead. Tonight that may be a mercy or it may be the end of me.
Down on the boards, back to the wall, same as the wheelhouse.

frames.action: press 'H' -- no, I already set it for dawn; nothing on the screen changed
frames.commentary: I already set it. Dawn, and not a minute of it wasted.

frames.action: press 'N' -- no second alarm, the dawn one will do
frames.commentary: No. The one I set will do. Goodnight, then, whatever that is worth in here.

frames.action: press 'Y' -- yes, stop, something just bit at me
frames.commentary: Something tried to take a piece out of me. I am awake now.

frames.action: press 'Left' -- two dogs and the dead behind them, get to the door
frames.commentary: Two dogs on me and the dead coming up behind them. The door. Get the door open.

frames.action: press 'Left' -- stand in the doorway itself
frames.commentary: Stand in it. In a doorway they come at me one at a time.

frames.action: press 'Left' -- out, one more step and the door is between us
frames.commentary: Out. One more step and there is a door between us.

frames.action: press 'c' -- shut it on them; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: Shut it. A dog cannot work a handle. That is my whole plan.

frames.action: press 'Right' -- swing at the one in the doorway
frames.commentary: I cannot outrun a dog. But one at a time I have six feet of rod.
Again. Keep it in the gap.
Keep it in the gap. Do not let it past me.
Six at a time. It has maybe thirty in it. I can count.
My arm is bleeding. Keep swinging.
One of us is going to stop first.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- no, I am not winning this, get out into the open
frames.commentary: No. I am not winning this. My right arm is going. Out into the open.
Move. The dogs are quick but the dead are slow.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- clear that away, I have no time for it
frames.commentary: One. That is one. I have no time to be proud of it.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- the dogs are off me, keep walking
frames.commentary: The dogs are off me. One of them is not getting up again. Walk.
North. Steady. Do not run out of breath.
The dead do not hurry and neither will I.
Northwest, off this concrete and away from that shopfront.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- a hardware store, of all places; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: A hardware store. Of all places to be chased into, I will take it.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- get in among the racking; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: Get in among the racking. I know my way around a place like this.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- further in; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: Further in. Away from the glass.

frames.action: press 'Up' -- deeper; nothing in the map column changed
press 'Left' -- that is a wall, go along it instead
frames.commentary: That is a wall, not a way in. Along it, then.
West. There will be a door in it somewhere.

frames.action: press 'y' -- northwest; nothing in the map column changed
press 'y' -- keep going; nothing in the map column changed
frames.commentary: Keep going. They are behind me and they are slow.
West, along the brick, feeling for a door with my eyes.
My arm is stiffening up. Keep walking.
Thirty-one years of standing on a wet deck. I can walk.

frames.action: press 'Left' -- west onto the road, away from the mass of them
frames.commentary: West, onto the road. More behind me than I care to count.
One foot then the other. That is all it has ever been.
I am fifty-two and my arm is ruined and I am still walking.

frames.action: press 'Left' -- something has my leg, pull free and keep going
frames.commentary: Something has my leg. Pull. Pull and keep going.
West, and do not look back at it.
The arm is worse. I can still hold the rod in the left.
They are falling behind. Slowly, but they are.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- turn on the dog, it is the only thing fast enough to follow me
frames.commentary: The dog is the only one of them quick enough to keep up. So the dog goes first.
Swing. My waders have taken every bite so far.
Again. I did this once already tonight.

frames.action: press 'n' -- southeast is the only side of me that is clear
frames.commentary: Southeast is the only side of me with nothing on it. Go. Go now.

frames.action: press 'n' -- keep going while my legs will carry me
frames.commentary: My wind is going. Thirty-one seasons and it is my wind that goes first.
Camille. Tell her I was walking toward her.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- turn and face them, I will not be taken from behind
frames.commentary: No more running. No wind left. Turn and face it.
Thirty-one seasons and never taken from behind. Not tonight.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- swing; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Y' -- yes, with my hands then
frames.commentary: They have my rod and they have my arms and I cannot breathe. Then my hands. Yes.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- hit it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'I' -- stop asking me and let me swing
frames.commentary: Stop asking me. Let me swing.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- hit it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'Down' -- hit it; nothing on the screen changed
press 'C' -- my last words, and there is only one name for them
frames.commentary: There is only one name worth spending my last breath on.

frames.action: press 'period' -- and that is the whole of it
press 'Return' -- set it down and let go
frames.commentary: That is the whole of it. Set it down and let go.

frames.action: press 'N' -- no, I do not need it played back to me
frames.commentary: No. I was there for it.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- close the record of it
frames.commentary: That is the record of it. Close it.

frames.action: press 'N' -- declined the diary prompt, and the capture that followed shows the post-death scores screen (ACHIEVEMENTS / CONDUCTS / SCORES / KILLS)
frames.commentary: No. What I said stands, and it was one word.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- closed the scores screen, and the capture that followed shows the follower epilogue
frames.commentary: A tally. One dog. Nine hours. That is what I was worth on the day.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- close the last of it
frames.commentary: Forgotten among the billions. Camille would have known.

frames.action: press 'Escape' -- close the follower epilogue and let the record end
frames.commentary: Forgotten among the billions. Camille knew where I was going.
